pamAccessSshRules.documentation: SSH authorization rules per server group

pamAccessSudoRules.documentation: Sudo authorization rules per server group

pamAccessRp.documentation: OIDC RP name for PAM tokens

pamAccessHeartbeatInterval.documentation: Expected heartbeat interval from PAM servers (seconds)

pamAccessInactiveThreshold.documentation: Maximum age of the calling server's last heartbeat accepted by /pam/authorize when pamAccessHeartbeatRequired is enabled (seconds, default 900)

pamAccessHeartbeatRequired.documentation: Refuse /pam/authorize when the calling server has not sent a heartbeat within pamAccessInactiveThreshold seconds

pamAccessExportedVars.documentation: Exported variables for PAM user provisioning

pamAccessOfflineEnabled.documentation: Enable offline mode for PAM authorization caching

pamAccessServerGroups.documentation: Authoritative mapping of enrolled OIDC client_id to server group. When non-empty, /pam/authorize enforces the group from this map instead of trusting the request body.

pamAccessBastionGroups.documentation: Comma-separated list of server groups whose hosts may be vouched for as bastions

pamAccessChoice.documentation: Choice sub-module used by PamAccess server-to-server endpoints (must match an entry of authChoiceModules). Leave empty when Choice auth is not used.

pamAccessBastionCertPinSourceAddress.documentation: Pin the ephemeral certificate issued by /pam/bastion-cert to the bastion's IP (source-address critical option), so a leaked cert is only usable from the bastion that requested it. Recommended when there is no NAT/PAT between the bastion and the portal. Leave disabled when the address LLNG observes differs from the bastion's SSH egress address (reverse proxy, multi-homed bastion, NAT/PAT). Default 0 (disabled).

pamAccessRequireFingerprint.documentation: Refuse /pam/verify and /pam/authorize when the caller supplies no SSH fingerprint, instead of falling back to the unbound behaviour

pamAccessBastionVoucherUnboundTtl.documentation: Maximum lifetime of a bastion voucher minted without an SSH fingerprint, i.e. one that nothing binds to the user's SSO certificate expiry (seconds)

pamAccessAllowedRps.documentation: Comma-separated list of OIDC relying-party configuration keys allowed to call /pam/*. Empty (default) accepts any device-grant token carrying a pam scope, which is the historical behaviour. When set, it also forbids a caller from declaring a bastion server_group in the request body: bastion groups must then come from pamAccessServerGroups.

pamAccessRequestSigningMode.documentation: Verification of the X-Signature-256 / X-Timestamp / X-Nonce headers sent by the open-bastion PAM client. 'optional' accepts unsigned requests but still refuses a bad signature: use it while rolling the secret out, then switch to 'required'.

pamAccessRequestSigningSecret.documentation: Shared secret used to verify signed PAM requests. Must equal request_signing_secret in the open-bastion client configuration.

pamAccessRequestSigningWindow.documentation: Accepted clock skew, in seconds, for X-Timestamp. Also the lifetime of the nonce replay cache entries.

select.v: Default (RP ID token algorithm, else RS256)

pamAccessResponseSigningAlg.documentation: Algorithm of the signed answers of /pam/authorize, /pam/verify, /pam/userinfo, /pam/whoami and /pam/heartbeat, sent when a caller asks for them (Accept: application/ob-pam-response+jwt). Empty (default): the PAM relying party's ID token signature algorithm when it is asymmetric, else RS256. The key is the RP's signing key, else oidcServiceSignatureKey; it must match the algorithm's key type. Symmetric (HS*) and 'none' are never used.
